fields.name: Source
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x6741A0 ecl::timeline::ArenaDecisionSystem::AddScriptEvents resolves the Guid at +0 to an entity (EoCClient.dll+0x6751A0) and puts it, with its position, in the first entity slot of an arena event of kind 4 (ArenaEventToString: OnScriptEvent). In AddDeathEvents (EoCClient.dll+0x673580) that first slot holds DeathComponent +0 (DeathData::Cause), the second the dying entity: the first slot is the event's source.

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x6741A0 ecl::timeline::ArenaDecisionSystem::AddScriptEvents resolves the Guid at +0x10 to an entity and puts it, with its position, in the second entity slot of an OnScriptEvent arena event; in AddDeathEvents (EoCClient.dll+0x673580) that slot holds the entity that died while the first holds the death's Cause: the second slot is the event's subject.
